turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you freeze bread dough? I'd love fresh bread on weekdays without the effort.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can. Freeze it after the first rise and shaping, wrapped tightly. It keeps for about a month.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Changing the subject, my friends are coming over to learn a new game tonight, and the rulebook is twenty pages long.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's chunky. Would you rather read the whole rulebook to them first, or explain the basics and learn the rest as you play?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, can you stay quiet for a minute? I need to talk to my partner. I'll come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Your dog has stolen that poor kid's ball again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He's not dropping it. He's doing laps.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: He thinks it's a game now. Have you got any treats on you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Some liver ones in my pocket. Here.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Rufus, look! Treat! Okay, good boy, give.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There we go. Should we apologise to the dad?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, and offer him a sticky, slightly chewed ball back. Lovely.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll go. You put the lead on before he spots the frisbee.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. The long rulebook for tonight. Read first or learn as you play?
